description: footprint is an R package that estimates air-travel carbon emissions from IATA airport codes or coordinates. Its README describes great-circle distance calculation and factors from the United Kingdom's 2019 greenhouse-gas conversion-factor report. Users provide trip endpoints and passenger details; outputs are estimated travel distance and carbon footprint. Geographic coverage is international air routes represented by the airport or coordinate inputs. GitHub metadata states CC0-1.0 for the repository; source factor publications may have separate terms. A limitation is that a great-circle route and an older national factor cannot represent every aircraft, load, stop or future fuel mix. The package can prepare aviation emissions estimates for transport or institutional-service scenarios. The related Brightway catalogue platform performs broader life-cycle analysis. No flight data or package was downloaded.
name: footprint air-travel carbon calculator
